title: Selector and product coupling disagree
statement: Choose independent uniform bits $U,V$ and independent uniform signs $X,Y\in\{-1,1\}$. Select $U$ for sign $+1$ and $V$ for sign $-1$, and let $A$ be the probability that the selections using $X$ and $Y$ agree. Separately, choose a uniform bit and independently resample a uniform bit; let $B$ be the probability that they agree. Then $A\ne B$.
